items: Center notified 11 new international ports (9 land ports + 2 airports), expanding e-visa entry ports to 88 across India.
**New Additions:** 11 ports = 9 land ports + 2 airports (**Bhopal and Tirupati**).
**Total e-Visa Ports:** Reached **88 ports** (37 Airports + 38 Seaports + 13 Land Ports).
≠ **Airport Additions:** The 2 new airports notified are Bhopal and Tirupati.
